scope_note: 15 supplemental interface contracts refine the preserved baseline; they do not replace or renumber its 181 requirements. Phase priority and dependencies remain unchanged. UI-11 has bounded P01 input evidence; all 14 full acceptance cases remain unrun. Introduction means first actual proof, completion means stated breadth; later platform/quality regression still applies. UI-03/UI-11 explicitly distinguish P03 foundational qualification from later full-domain completion; this does not postpone their early proofs.

contracts.contract: Four complementary action-access levels with one semantic action vocabulary
contracts.evidence_scope: P01 captured farm offers, fixed target/intent/revisions, bounded stale/duplicate/session checks and native controls only. Full wheels/action library, P03 foundation and completion-phase acceptance remain open.

contracts.contract: Stable customizable quick wheels with browsable full-action access
Scoped offers, target identity and authoritative confirmation/recovery
contracts.evidence_scope: P01 captured farm offers, fixed target/intent/revisions, bounded stale/duplicate/session checks and native controls only. Full wheels/action library, P03 foundation and completion-phase acceptance remain open.

contracts.partial_evidence_scope: P01 textual cost/blocker inspection prerequisite at 960x540 via native focus/hover; icons, rich item cards, physical navigation and full UIV-14 remain unimplemented/unrun.

cases.acceptance: Choose a person, harvestable and damaged object; read action and target; change target/range/stock before confirmation. No implicit attack, gift, theft, consumption or nearest-target substitution; host rejection explains only permitted facts.
cases.partial_evidence_scope: P01 farm gathering/crafting/gift/quest captured-intent regressions and native target/cost checks. Full damaged-object and target/confirmation flow is not run.

cases.acceptance: Populate a labeled synthetic mature library (initial comparison: 200 known actions across disciplines) and small real early library. Favorites keep stable identities after learning, depletion, equipment changes and restart; every known action has a browsable non-search-only route. Native action execution is claimed only for actually implemented commands.

Compare nonmagical actor, fighter with a usable enchanted item, learned spellcaster with zero mana, discovered-but-unlearned discipline, lost capability and companion control. Relevant menus appear without class checks or secret leakage; essential controls/costs remain visible.

Open wheel, target, inventory, child confirmation and text entry; cancel each; change device, resize, disconnect and lose focus. Check event and polled movement paths, opener release, neutral-stick release and focus restoration. No extra movement, ration craft, item use or accidental submission.
cases.partial_evidence_scope: P01 dialogue/pause/focus and held-control prerequisite only. Full wheel/target/inventory/confirmation/text-entry/device/resize/disconnect case is not run.

cases.acceptance: Complete the same actual loop with keyboard-only/discrete navigation, mouse and gamepad; rebind including conflicts and reset. Prompts update, confirm/cancel remain reachable, linear alternatives and toggle operation avoid analog precision, simultaneous chords or mandatory holds.

Zoom from a known local place to regional/world views; select upstairs, sewer, known plane and historical map. Preserve anchor and address, distinguish reports/old maps and actual exploration, and return to current location. No map zoom reveals secrets or travels; stale asynchronous results cannot replace the newer requested view.

Begin with the small real P02 stats/inventory/equipment/recipe and trade subset; expand through deep production/jobs at P04 and crew/settlement screens in their existing phases. Preview vs commit, progression spending, bulk review, reservations, remote stock and delegate orders obey custody, effort and control. UI filtering/sorting does not transform or teleport goods.

Show real appointment dates, relative job durations, crop/weather estimates and changed NPC commitments across Wait/branch states. Calendar labels name the clock; maps/notes distinguish observation dates and uncertainty. Viewing or dismissing schedules never changes time.

Show learned interdisciplinary skills and supported magic/research with known prerequisites, teacher/practice routes and meaningful cross-links. Simple view remains sufficient for ordinary use; no giant omniscient graph, missing usable ability or inert mandatory tab.

Run actual solo, coordinated and separated four-player menu/encounter cases. World time indicator matches authority; opening/closing one menu releases only its own permitted hold; invalidated controls/targets, late join and commit-before-disconnect recover without duplicate effects or secret projection.

Restore profile remaps/favorites after restart and package migration; switch actors/worlds/branches. Exact-instance and declared-family bindings stay distinct, deleted definitions remain removable unavailable entries, private notes/discoveries stay scoped, and restored menus never replay clicks.

Retain native novice/expert sessions on declared input devices/resolutions and real full catalogs by P12. Measure wrong-action submissions, navigation depth/time, help requests, abandoned searches, unreadable states, accidental execution, repetition and distraction. Set candidate thresholds before each packet; require independent review and human acceptance, not an inferred pass from screenshots or unit tests.

Verify actual desktop production profiles, localization/scaling and input/accessibility; then touch, safe areas, virtual keyboard, suspend/resume and co-op parity on supported mobile devices. Every supported action remains reachable without hover or hardware-key-only instructions.

Begin with actual P02 item/action/disabled-state icons and rich hover/focus/Inspect cards. Native users can recognize frequent icons, reveal the same permitted details without executing an action, compare equipment and read pinned long text at scaled sizes without flicker, clipping or hidden essential costs. Unidentified artifacts reveal no secret power/value/quest role through icon, tooltip, search or accessible name. P03 tests target invalidation, live-state staleness and menu/Wait policy; later domains extend known/earned details; P11 closes icon/description/localization coverage, P12 verifies recognition and reading comfort, P13 desktop and P14 touch prove parity.
cases.partial_evidence_scope: P01 known blocked crafting inspection and visible costs through native Control focus/hover only. Full icon/Inspect/knowledge/localization/device case is not run.
